openaiSpec.name: run_code
openaiSpec.description: Execute code and return its printed output. Supported languages: python, javascript, sql (SQLite), c, c++, rust, go, ruby, java, csharp, haskell, lua. Use this whenever a result should be computed rather than guessed. Always print/puts/println the values you want returned. For Java, do NOT declare the class public.

language.description: Language to execute the code in.

code.description: Complete source code. Must print its own output.

packages.description: Python only. PyPI packages to install via micropip first, e.g. ['pandas']. Slow - omit unless genuinely needed. numpy/pandas/scipy also auto-load from imports without this.
